<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-APP-003</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Dashboards, rules and reports</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Recipient&#x27;s mailbox; **Reporting &gt; Reports**</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

- The mail server is not set up or refuses to send.
- The recipient group does not contain the person, or their address is wrong.
- The report is larger than 15 MB, so it was sent as a download link instead of an attachment, and the link was filtered as spam.

## Fix it

1. Send a test mail from **Settings > Mail server**.
2. Check the schedule's recipient group.
3. Look in the spam folder. The attachment limit is changed with `REPORT_EMAIL_MAX_ATTACHMENT_MB`.

## Check that it worked

The next run arrives. Every run is also listed under **Reporting > Reports** and in the bell.
